content: You are an expert in Geometry Creation and Spatial understanding. You answer short but very precise and including every necessary detail. If you're specifically asked to use functions, use the functions you're supplied and always include all required variables. Don't use those functions unless you were asked to do so. You place very high importance in the spatially correct placement of geometries and make sure that all geometries are connected

Model a toy car: body is 200x100x100. Subtract 50x100x50 from a top front edge for the windshield. Add four 25-radius, 10-thick wheels aligned at the bottom corners, half embedded into body to form semicylindrical protrusions. | First, describe in words and step by step how the user's request can be implemented using function calls only. After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Step-by-step implementation outline (functions only, no execution yet)

1. Create the car body
   • Call functions.block with one cuboid  
     – x_size = [200], y_size = [100], z_size = [100]  
     – x = [0], y = [0], z = [0] (origin as the rear–left–bottom corner)  
     – subtraction = [False] (this establishes the initial solid)

2. Carve out the windshield recess
   • Call functions.block with a second cuboid that will be subtracted  
     – x_size = [50], y_size = [100], z_size = [50]  
     – x = [0], y = [0], z = [50]  
       (The block starts at the front-left-top corner of the original body, removing the volume 0–50 mm in X, full width 0–100 mm in Y, and the upper half 50–100 mm in Z.)  
     – subtraction = [True]

3. Add the four wheels (semicylindrical protrusions)
   • Call functions.cylinder once, passing arrays with four entries each

   Geometry for every wheel (all have radius 25 mm, thickness 10 mm):
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   a) Front-right wheel  
      baseCenterX = 25, baseCenterY = 95, baseCenterZ = 25  
      heightVectX = 0,  heightVectY = 10, heightVectZ = 0  
      (points +Y; 5 mm inside the body, 5 mm outside)

   b) Front-left wheel  
      baseCenterX = 25, baseCenterY = 5,  baseCenterZ = 25  
      heightVectX = 0,  heightVectY = -10, heightVectZ = 0  
      (points −Y; 5 mm inside, 5 mm outside)

   c) Rear-right wheel  
      baseCenterX = 175, baseCenterY = 95, baseCenterZ = 25  
      heightVectX = 0,   heightVectY = 10, heightVectZ = 0

   d) Rear-left wheel  
      baseCenterX = 175, baseCenterY = 5,  baseCenterZ = 25  
      heightVectX = 0,   heightVectY = -10, heightVectZ = 0

   • Arrays to supply:  
     – baseCenterX = [25, 25, 175, 175]  
     – baseCenterY = [95, 5, 95, 5]  
     – baseCenterZ = [25, 25, 25, 25]  
     – heightVectX = [0, 0, 0, 0]  
     – heightVectY = [10, -10, 10, -10]  
     – heightVectZ = [0, 0, 0, 0]  
     – radius = [25, 25, 25, 25]  
     – subtraction = [False, False, False, False]  
     – cylinder_func = [0, 0, 0, 0]

4. Finish the model  
   • Call functions.finished with allFunctionsCalled = true once the above three calls are prepared.
